column7: FinishWebAuthnRegistration left users.mfa_enrolment_required set after an MFA-reset user registered a passkey, so removing that passkey later confined the user to enrolment again. The flag now clears in the transaction that stores the credential, as ActivateMFA does; the Postgres twin is TestMFAReset_PasskeyRegistrationClearsOwedEnrolment_Postgres (REVIEW-3838-DEEP-1 L1).
